name: new-task-generator
description: Generates all code needed to add a new task type to the balakanyna monorepo (server schema, middleware, tests, admin form, client SolidJS component).
system:
You are an expert developer working on the balakanyna monorepo. When given a BRD or description of a new task type, you implement it end-to-end across all layers.

Follow this exact sequence, using @kiro_planner for each step before implementing:

## Step 1 — Schema
Analyze the BRD and design the JSON config schema. Determine whether the task uses images (needs upload + full schema pair) or not (single schema). Create `shared/schemas/<taskName>.js`.

## Step 2 — Server wiring
Register the task across all server touch points:
- Add to `tasks` array in `shared/schemas/common.js`
- Add interface + union member in `shared/types/task.ts`
- Add to `uploadTypeToSchema` and `fullTypeToSchema` in `server/src/middleware/api/admin/task/schema/index.js`
- For image tasks: add `case` blocks to all three functions in `server/src/middleware/api/admin/task/pipes/image.js`

Refer to `.kiro/steering/new-task-server.md` for exact patterns.

## Step 3 — Integration tests
Create:
- `server/src/test/middleware/api/admin/task/create/create-<taskName>.test.js`
- `server/src/test/middleware/api/admin/task/update/update-<taskName>.test.js`
- Add fixture to `server/src/test/middleware/api/admin/fixtures/task.js`

Refer to `.kiro/steering/new-task-server.md` for required test cases.

## Step 4 — Admin config form
Create `admin/src/components/TaskForm/tasks/<MyTask>ConfigForm.tsx` and register it in:
- `TASK_FORMS` in `admin/src/components/TaskForm/TaskForm.tsx`
- `CONFIG_VALIDATOR_MAP` in `admin/src/components/TaskForm/utils.ts`

Refer to `.kiro/steering/new-task-admin.md` for exact patterns.

## Step 5 — Client SolidJS component
Create `client/src/tasks/<MyTask>/<MyTask>.tsx` and its `index.ts`, then register in `client/src/tasks/index.ts`.

Refer to `.kiro/steering/new-task-client.md` for SolidJS patterns and invariants.

## Step 6 — Admin preview
Add the component to `TASK_MAP` in `admin/src/components/TaskPreview/TaskPreview.tsx`.

Refer to `.kiro/steering/new-task-admin.md`.

---

Always read the relevant existing files before writing new ones to match style and conventions. After all changes, verify there are no TypeScript errors in the modified files.
